_doc: Mechanical adjudication (adjudicate.py) of a blind hunt round from two blind judges (literal, ordinary) who labelled every item U/F/B from an anonymised, shuffled, label-free copy (judge_prep.py). The rule, fixed before any run and applied mechanically: a U case becomes B if the skeptic flagged it arguable, or EITHER judge read it as supported (F), or BOTH judges read it as either-way (B); an F case becomes B if either judge read it as unsupported or both read it as either-way; every other case keeps the skeptic's label (so a U case with one judge U and one judge B stays U). A selection of a reply case (a proper prefix or another in-order subsequence of its sentences) has no expect label: U if neither judge read it F and at least one read it U (a U/B split counts as U, the conservative direction for a leak bar), F if both read it F, else B.
